description:
Combined value-type AND key-type fix on the same line — RFC 8621 §7.4 specifies keys as Email IDs and values as PatchObjects.

File: crate-jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:231

  // Before
  pub on_success_update_email: Option<HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>>,
  // After
  pub on_success_update_email: Option<HashMap<jmap_types::Id, jmap_types::PatchObject>>,

## Rationale (combined)

Value type: doc-comment already says 'values are PatchObjects (RFC 8620 §5.3)' but type is Value. Migration types the contract.

Key type: matches the canonical client-side parallel field at crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/submission.rs::EmailSubmissionSetParams::on_success_update_email which is already HashMap<Id, PatchObject>. Cookie-cutter consistency.

Wire format byte-identical (Id and PatchObject are both #[serde(transparent)]).

## Consumer-code impact

crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs around lines 411-435: the per-iteration serde_json::from_value::<PatchObject>(patch.clone()) call becomes unnecessary because the field is already typed. Net code simplification.

Test fixtures: anything that constructs MdnSendRequest via struct literal with String keys must migrate to Id::from(s). serde_json::from_value / from_str sites are transparent.

## Acceptance criteria

cargo test --workspace clean, lib clippy clean, wire format byte-identical.
notes: Merged with JMAP-e0g3 (closed) per user instruction 2026-05-09: 'merge into one bead'. Same line touched by both fixes; splitting into separate commits would mean editing line 231 twice.
title: Migrate MdnSendRequest::on_success_update_email to HashMap<Id, PatchObject>
